findings.claim: In artifact.md the Activity 1 static alternative uses 'Built safely' in options A, C and D ('Option A: Built safely. Listener: ...'), but the definition lives only in HTML task step 2, which the Markdown companion doesn't carry. A Markdown or print-from-Markdown reader gets an undefined term in three of four options. The HTML-only reader is unaffected.
findings.recommendation: Define the term inside the data-static-alt text (e.g. start it with 'Built safely means each item is created with createElement, data-id set with setAttribute and the text with textContent.'), so the companion is self-contained whatever the generator fix turns out to be.

items.note: The gate doesn't work. The new script (end of file) sets recap.hidden = !done, but the page CSS rule '.pep-recap, .pep-sources { ...; display: flex; ... }' (style line 318) beats the UA [hidden]{display:none} rule, and there is no [hidden] override. Verified in headless Chromium at 390x844 on first load: [data-pep-recap] has hidden=true, but computed display is 'flex', its height is 919px, .pep-cheat has an offsetParent, and the note 'The recap and cheat sheet appear here once all 3 activities are done.' renders right above the visible recap. The visible content still decides answers: 'const item = event.target.closest(selector); // also works for clicks on child elements' (A1 D over A), '// run order: plain code, then microtasks (then, await), then the next task (setTimeout)' (A2), and the recap's 'show detail for what to fix' (A3 C over D). Fix: add '.pep-recap[hidden], .pep-recap-note[hidden] { display: none; }' (keep print), then re-verify in a browser.

The 'Two reminders' paragraph is removed. Only one joining sentence remains before the options: 'calling an async function runs its body at once, up to its first await, and then returns a promise to the caller.' It rules out only distractor A and matches the module.json joining detail. The queue rule and the already-fulfilled point are now in hint 2, and 'Commit to an order before you check' replaced the unenforceable instruction.
The fit Good fit is now 'Any content that comes from visitors or an API, including items added after the page has loaded.' It no longer gives the 'as text / one parent listener' recipe.

Activity 1 hint 2 now asks the learner to check whether text 'passes through anything that builds elements from a string' and to trace a heart-icon click. Activity 3 hint 2 now asks the learner to trace the 400 and 502 through each option, then 'which member's value would tell the reviewer what to change?'. Both are reasoning steps, not the deciding fact.

Activity 3 option D is now a full, parallel code block differing from C only in problem.title. The correct Activity 1 option (D) is self-contained, and the shared construction is factored into a defined term.

Activity 1 is now a new cumulative problem. The heart-icon span inside the button makes both the original matches('li') listener and a new matches('button.like') distractor fail, the XSS payload changed to an onmouseover link, and both are needed to choose. Activity 3 adds a POST, a 400 problem+json and title vs detail on top of the topic page's 502 case. The Vite proxy and VITE_API_URL are still context only and no option depends on them, which is acceptable for review framing.
Task step 2 defines 'Built safely' once, so options A, C and D are now short and differ only in the listener. Comparing options is now quick.
